script: set +e; URL='https://e.givesmart.com/events/KHN/'; sudo -u azureuser /usr/bin/google-chrome --headless=new --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --virtual-time-budget=15000 --dump-dom "$URL" 2>/dev/null > /tmp/giv1.html; echo '--- ticket/buy links ---'; grep -oE 'href="[^"]*(?:ticket|buy|cart|store|item)[^"]*"' /tmp/giv1.html | sort -u | head -30; echo '--- data-* attrs with prices ---'; grep -oE 'data-[a-z-]+="[^"]*(?:price|amount|ticket)[^"]*"' /tmp/giv1.html | sort -u | head -20; echo '--- common GiveSmart endpoints ---'; for endpoint in /tickets /store /items /buy /buyTickets /purchase; do u2="https://e.givesmart.com/events/KHN${endpoint}"; size=$(sudo -u azureuser /usr/bin/google-chrome --headless=new --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --virtual-time-budget=10000 --dump-dom "$u2" 2>/dev/null | wc -c); echo "$u2 = $size bytes"; done
